annotations.title: Snap a node onto a surface

description:
Move one 3D node along a ray until it sits at the given gap on the first surface (floor, ramp, shelf, table), then save the scene. Returns before and after transforms and the evidence.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/snap-to-surface"}

alignUp.description: Rotate the subject's current world up toward an exact physics contact normal before seating it.

direction.description: Finite world-space cast direction [x,y,z] whose squared length exceeds 0.00001. Defaults downward.

gap.description: Requested separation from the support surface; must not exceed maxDistance.

maxDistance.description: Maximum cast and overlap-recovery distance in scene units.

scenePath.description: Exact scene containing the subject, e.g. 'res://levels/market.tscn'

subjectPath.description: Exact Node3D path relative to the scene root, e.g. './Props/Crate'
